executive_summary: Ad performance for July 2026 shows a significant increase in costs compared to historical benchmarks. While overall CTR remains healthy at 3.87%, the cost per message has spiked to over ₱90 in recent campaigns, nearly 5x higher than the ₱16.85 achieved in April 2026. Current daily operations are generating 30 messages at a ₱9.39 CPC. Efficiency is being hampered by extremely high CPMs averaging ₱363.62, suggesting either high audience saturation or overly restrictive targeting in the 'Metro South' region.

best_campaigns.reason: Achieved the lowest recent cost per message at ₱41.29 on July 20th and maintains a strong 4.68% CTR.
Highest volume of messages (7) in a single day (July 3rd) with a competitive 5.23% CTR.

worst_campaigns.reason: Poor efficiency with a historical cost per message of ₱141.22 and very low message volume relative to spend.
Historical performance shows a ₱167.41 cost per message, indicating a failed lead generation strategy for that period.

winning_ads.insight: Highest performing creative currently active. Strong financial hook (monthly payment) driving engagement.
Strong historical engagement, though currently paused. Xpander remains a high-intent model.

creative_insights.insight: Historically the most efficient model for sales conversions (₱16.85 - ₱17.14 per message). Performance drops when bundled into 'Multi-Model' campaigns.
Best for top-of-funnel engagement and CTR (5.68%). Specific monthly payment callouts (₱15K+/Month) perform better than general 'Low DP' hooks.
The 'Client Release Video' and general video ads show lower cost per message historically (₱46.51) compared to current static images in July.

historical_insights.detail: Cost per message has risen from ₱16.85 (April 2026) to ₱92.19 (July 2026). This is a 447% increase in acquisition cost.
Historical CPMs were ₱28.34 in April. July CPMs have reached ₱433.24. This suggests the audience in Metro South is likely exhausted or under heavy competition.

recommendations.suggestion: Pause '📁 2026 | Sales | Multi Models | July' and shift budget to '📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY' specifically targeting the Mirage G4 creative.
Expand targeting beyond 'Metro South'. The ₱363+ CPM is unsustainable. Test a broader 'Mega Manila' or nationwide lookalike audience (LLA) based on previous L300 buyers.
Return to model-specific campaigns for the L300. Historical data proves that dedicated L300 Sales campaigns outperform 'Multi Model' clusters by a significant margin.
Re-introduce Video Creatives. The historical 'Client Release Video' and 'TRY VIDEO ADS' campaign showed much better cost-efficiency than current static ads.
Standardize the '90 Days Free / 2 Months Waived Amortization' hook across all models, as this primary text showed strong historical engagement in the Mirage campaigns.
